content.equation:
Anion_Gap = Na - (Cl + HCO3)
Delta_Gap = Anion_Gap - Baseline_Gap
Delta_HCO3 = 25 - HCO3
Delta_Delta_Gradient = Delta_Gap - Delta_HCO3
